title: Campus Firestorm
situation: A campus conversation about Gaza becomes polarized and emotionally charged.
decisionPoint: How do you lower harm and create a learning space?
responsibleNextStep: Create a structured, facilitated learning space.

title: Responsible Giving Decision
situation: A donor sees many claims and organizations online and wants to help.
decisionPoint: How do you choose a responsible route?
responsibleNextStep: Use official organization channels only where evidence and review allow.

title: Technology Tool Without Harm
situation: A university team wants to build a map or matching tool.
decisionPoint: How do you avoid exposing vulnerable people or operational details?
responsibleNextStep: Prepare a technology risk checklist for advisor review.

title: WASH Alert
situation: Water and sanitation risks create public-health concerns.
decisionPoint: How do you communicate risk without giving medical advice?
responsibleNextStep: Use official public-health guidance and reviewed WASH pathways.

title: Temporary Learning in a Tent Setting
situation: Children are displaced and schooling is disrupted.
role: Teacher, student organizer, or university partner
decisionPoint: How can learning continue while protecting children?
responsibleNextStep: Support reviewed temporary learning and child protection actors.
reflectionPrompts: Who is responsible for child protection?

title: Youth Leadership Under Pressure
situation: Young people want to act, but the environment is polarized and emotionally intense.
decisionPoint: How do you support agency without exposing people to harm?
responsibleNextStep: Route youth leadership through reviewed, partner-mediated programs.
reflectionPrompts: What choice does the young person have?

title: Public Narrative and Dehumanization
situation: A public post or speech risks dehumanizing a group.
decisionPoint: How do you preserve moral clarity without dehumanization?
responsibleNextStep: Use a public narrative review checklist before sharing.

title: Leading a Team in Crisis
situation: A group wants to help but is overwhelmed, reactive, and unfocused.
decisionPoint: How do you turn urgency into disciplined action?
responsibleNextStep: Create a 90-day leadership experiment with review gates.
